programmes.d: The FIM Supermoto World Championship, also known as S1GP, is the premier international competition for Supermoto racing, first held in 2002.

The FIM Sidecarcross World Championship is an international motocross racing series featuring sidecar motorcycles. In this championship, a rider and a passenger (the "passenger" often referred to as the "passenger" or "monkey") work together to navigate challenging off-road tracks.

Extreme Winter Test: We push the Mercedes G 580 EQ to its limits on the snowy Timmelsjoch High Alpine Road and uncover all the pros and cons of the new electric drivetrain. Does the electric G still feel like a true G-Class? And we get an exclusive drive in the new, still camouflaged CLA.
We visited a Hot Rod Hanger near Vienna with the largest private Mopa Muscle car collection in Europe. The entire collection has been built up by over the last 30 years by a true artist: Knud Tiroch.
